rationale: The discourse shows broad agreement on the need for durable competitiveness, but the core conflict remains unresolved: management/shareholders insist on economically equivalent restructuring that may include closures, while the union, works council, and state reject closures and compulsory redundancies. Positions are hardening rather than converging, yet there is still active testing of alternatives, so another round could still clarify whether a negotiated equivalent package is feasible.
